name: Authgear
description: Customer identity and access management platform with authentication flows, MFA, and OAuth2/OIDC support.

envVars.description: Password for the Authgear Postgres database user
Master encryption key used to protect Authgear secrets

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE_URL: "postgres://authgear:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/authgear"
      REDIS_URL: "redis://{{serviceName}}-redis:6379"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      AUTHGEAR_ONCE_ENCRYPTION_KEY: {{env.AUTHGEAR_ONCE_ENCRYPTION_KEY}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/config:/app/config
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: authgear
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: authgear
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
